questions.prompt: Which hand should play a bigger pot at 400bb?
questions.explanation: Nut potential, not the first pair you make.

choices.text: A clear mistake. The stack is too large for a one-card bluff.

questions.explanation: Bluff sizes and bluff hands shrink as the punishment grows.

questions.prompt: Very deep play still uses the same streets. What changes is…

choices.text: How strong a hand must be before you commit the stack.

questions.explanation: A straight still beats a pair. You just should not stack off the pair.

questions.prompt: A 200bb stack and a 40bb stack at the same table are…

choices.text: Two different games. Use the effective stack for each opponent.

questions.explanation: Covering someone does not make their pot deep.
